mechanism_summary: The metrics-db StatefulSet's volumeClaimTemplate names storageClassName fast-ssd, which does not exist on the cluster, so the PVC data-metrics-db-0 stays Pending unbound and the pod waits forever on its volume.
decisive_evidence: PVC analytics/data-metrics-db-0 is Pending with an event naming storageclass "fast-ssd" not found, while `kubectl get storageclasses` shows only 'standard'; the metrics-db-0 pod is Pending on the unbound claim, and the StatefulSet spec carries storageClassName fast-ssd.
remediation_summary: volumeClaimTemplates are immutable: delete the StatefulSet (kubectl -n analytics delete statefulset metrics-db), delete the stale Pending PVC data-metrics-db-0 (a recreated StatefulSet reuses an existing PVC by name, so the bad claim must go too), and re-apply the StatefulSet with storageClassName standard; the claim then provisions and the pod starts.
